theory.title: Articles and quantifiers
theory.explanation: Use a/an with singular countable nouns when mentioning something for the first time; use the for something specific or already known. Use some/any with plural countable and uncountable nouns. Use much with uncountable nouns and many with countable plurals; a few and a little mean a small but useful amount.
theory.tip: Observa si hablas de una experiencia terminada, una posibilidad, una habilidad o una norma. Esa diferencia determina la estructura.

content.passage: The new training centre has a small library and a computer room. There are many books about business, but there isn't much space for group work. The staff have ordered some new chairs and a little equipment for the meeting rooms. Each student receives an information pack on the first day. There are a few forms to complete, but the staff are available to answer questions. The centre does not charge students for the basic course materials.

content.audioTranscript: A: The centre has a new training programme. B: Who can join? A: Adult students who want to improve their skills. B: How do they apply for the course? A: They send their applications online. B: When will they receive confirmation? A: Within five working days. B: Who can they contact if they need help? A: The office.
